item.title: New Switch 2 Consoles Quietly Hide A Perfect 'Zelda' Homage
item.description: Lucky Nintendo fans who secured a pre-order for The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Switch 2 are starting to open the boxes containing their swanky new consoles — and are receiving a nice, unexpected surprise.

item.title: We Finally Know What Killed Mass Effect
item.description: On Oct. 21, EA announced that it was shutting down the beloved game studio BioWare and canceling its new Mass Effect sequel. The news was quite a blow, sparking theories that the studio was shut down because of pressure from Saudi Arabia’s Public Investment Fund, which recently bought out EA . Based on reporting from Bloomberg , we now know the main reason the publisher shut down BioWare: Star Wars.

item.title: Animal Crossing’s Biggest Competitor Officially Launches in December
item.description: After months of silence about its upcoming cozy life-sim HoYoverse finally set a Petit Planet release date. Petit Planet launches Dec. 4 for PC and mobile devices, with pre-load starting on Dec. 1; HoYoverse hasn't announced plans to launch Petit Planet on consoles yet.

item.title: 2026’s Secret 'Robin Hood' Movie Suddenly Drops on Streaming After Bombing in Theaters
item.description: Another 2026 box office flop is heading to streaming after a short theatrical run. The Uprising , which was briefly marketed in the U.S. as The Uprising: The Rise of Robin Hood , will stream exclusively on Peacock in early November.

item.title: HBO’s New Green Lantern Series Officially Gets an Important Update
item.description: DC and HBO first announced My Adventures with Green Lantern back in 2025, and updates since then have been sparse. It was briefly shown off during this year's Annecy International Animation Festival , but nothing at the convention was released publicly. Now, DC Studios co-lead Peter Safran has finally given a small but much-needed update on the project.

item.title: 6 Steam Games Coming Soon That Belong on Your Wishlist
item.description: Even though Steam Next Fest is over, we’re still sorting through all the games it put on our radar. While Steam’s recurring free demo event was invaded by generative AI games, it still featured plenty of human-made projects that cut through the slop. We’ve walked away from the event with a very long wishlist of upcoming PC games.

item.title: OpenAI Billionaire: PCs Are 'Terrible' When Data Centers Need More Memory
item.description: Here's a fun fact: from now until 2029, OpenAI owns 40% of the world's supply of Dynamic Random Access Memory (DRAM), which powers cell phones, video game consoles, and artificial intelligence. The ChatGPT maker is thus one of the key reasons you have to pay $650 for a PS5 now, and why no one can affordably build a new gaming PC. Somehow, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman thinks that percentage isn't enough.

item.title: 'Star Wars Fate of the Galaxy' Officially Released for Free
item.description: Never doubt the tenacity of Star Wars fans. After close to 20 years of development, a group of volunteers is finally releasing Fate of the Galaxy , a Star Wars space combat game built on FreeSpace 2 ’s open-source engine. This total conversion mod was developed using FreeSpace Open and is available for free on Linux, Mac, and PC .

item.title: Where to use the coin mining den key in DMZ in Modern Warfare 4
item.description: The coin mining den key in DMZ in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is one of many keys you can find in the extraction mode, used to unlock a locked door somewhere in the map that contains lots of loot behind it. Obtained by completing the "Operation Shopping Hacks" mission, the coin mining den key is described as opening the "e-coin mining lab in NuriGO West, east of the westernmost gas station inside NuriGO Mall."

item.title: James Gunn Officially Comments on Casting the DCU's New Batman
item.description: It has been clear for a while now that Robert Pattinson won't be the DC Universe's Batman, even with The Batman Part II still slated for release in 2028. Fans will be sad to see BatPat go, especially considering DC Studios co-head James Gunn has kept quiet on when we will see his successor. Thankfully, Gunn has finally given a small but meaningful update on the casting process for the next Bruce Wayne.
